title: Untitled (Crowns and Planes)
description: Panoramic mixed-media collage on white paper featuring loosely sketched figural torsos, compact discs, and crown motifs distributed across a wide horizontal field. Collaged elements include iridescent holographic strips, beaded crown forms, a warplane silhouette, and a small photographic face amid ink-drawn figures.
composition: wide horizontal scatter of figures and objects
